name: Nish Kumar
bio: Nishant "Nish" Kumar is a British stand-up comedian, actor, and radio presenter. He hosts Newsjack on BBC Radio 4 Extra.

credits.title: Russell Brand: Open Secret
credits.overview: From comedy stardom to a criminal trial, inside voices and archive footage charts British comedian Russell Brand's meteoric rise and steep fall following allegations of sexual offences.

credits.title: Nish Kumar: Nish, Don't Kill My Vibe
credits.overview: In Nish, Don’t Kill My Vibe, Nish Kumar brings his trademark blend of righteous fury and self-deprecating chaos to a world that feels like it’s permanently on fire.

credits.title: Clash of the Comics
credits.overview: The Edinburgh Comedy Award-winning, total sell-out, global cult sensation is coming to the Eventim Apollo for its biggest and most spectacular show yet. credits.title: Stuart Laws Has to Be Joking?
credits.overview: Last year Stuart started telling the truth on stage and was diagnosed autistic: he got the best reviews he’s ever got and his show was a must-see. He's back baby! And has to lean into it further. It’s funny, it’s real, it’s immaculately structured and it’s a chance to see a comedian at the top of his game.

credits.title: Stuart Laws? Is That Guy Still Going?
credits.overview: The Ruislip-based stand up has resolved to tell the truth, the whole truth and almost nothing but the truth. After an argument with his therapist about being too closed off, Stuart has resolved to come clean: sperm and all.

credits.title: And Mrs.
credits.overview: When a reluctant bride-to-be's fiancé drops dead, she insists on going ahead with the wedding anyway – vowing to overcome public opinion, the law of the land, and her loved ones' objections.

credits.title: Nish Kumar: Your Power, Your Control
credits.overview: "It has been a period of upheaval and uncertainty with COVID and the political situation. You will be amazed by my capacity to somehow take all these things personally." Your Power, Your Control is a new show from the former host of Late Night Mash and one of The Guardian's Top Top Fifty Comedians of the 21st Century.

credits.title: Enter the Spider-Verse: A Spider-Man Special
credits.overview: With Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse swinging into cinemas this summer, join our team of celebrity Spidey fans as they look back on over 20 years of web-slinging Spider-Man movies.

credits.title: Brave Creatures
credits.overview: In the heartlands of Elysia, a world on the brink of war, Aja risks all to reach a mysterious source which calls to her.
